body:
## 5.24.1

### Security

- Update the Mozilla CA certificate bundle (removes eMudhra certificates) ([#9206](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9206))
- Add `_FORTIFY_SOURCE`, CET/BTI on Linux, and explicit Windows mitigations ([#9167](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9167))
- Disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1 in `curl_certificate` and the OpenSSL build ([#9192](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9192), [#9202](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9202))
- Limit decompressed JetBrains plugin metadata size ([#9211](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9211))
- Disable shell command macro expansion in librpm ([#9223](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9223))
- Fix bounds checks and traversal for package BOM paths ([#9164](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9164), [#9184](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9184), [#9190](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9190))
- Correct the prefetch validation size check ([#9177](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9177))
- Guard against `npos` when joining arguments in `parseProcCmdline` ([#9176](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9176))
- Guard against truncated drive fields ([#9218](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9218))
- Check registry value size before decoding fixed-width types ([#9220](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9220))

### Bug Fixes

- Restore BPF tables removed in 5.24.0 ([#9225](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9225))
- Fix `chrome_extensions` state for modern Chromium profiles ([#9170](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9170))
- Fix Linux Audit argument reconstruction ([#9208](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9208))
- Fix an out-of-bounds read when comparing an empty path in `PathSet` ([#9188](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9188))
- Fix extension-table links in shell warnings ([#9186](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9186))
- Fix TLS connection reuse ([#9199](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9199))
- Return the full result string from the `carve()` SQL function ([#9191](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9191))
- Add a timeout around `statfs()` to handle hung filesystems ([#9175](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9175))
- Keep host and instance UUIDs stable when the database is reset ([#9203](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9203))
- Synchronize access to the custom flag map ([#9195](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9195))
- Preserve `IN` constraints when `xFilter` runs again for the same plan ([#9230](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9230))
- Record query performance when numeric monitoring is enabled ([#9219](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9219))
- Register all foreign table specs with `--enable_foreign` ([#9194](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9194))
- Serialize librpm global state in `rpm_packages` ([#9173](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9173))

### Documentation

- Make `PacksTests.test_sharding` independent of the shard cache ([#9182](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9182))
- Make `gpu_info` and Sleuth Kit table specs available on Windows ([#9210](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9210), [#9212](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9212))
- Document Docker prerequisites for Linux tests ([#9172](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9172))
- Fix the remote settings test walkthrough ([#9161](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9161))
- Assorted documentation fixes ([#9185](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/9185))

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/osquery/osquery/compare/5.24.0...5.24.1
